what: A button with a round arrow cell attached to the right of a pill text cell. On hover, after .05s the text cell is pushed right by the width of the arrow cell, a new arrow cell grows from 0 → 1 on the left, pivoting on its left edge (the arrow enters tilted 45° and straightens right away), and the right cell shrinks toward the right edge while its arrow tilts 45° — .735s on enter, .6s on leave, curve cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1). With no text cell and only two arrow cells, the arrow crosses over inside a round button

options.--fx-h: Button height = Arrow cell diameter, default 3em
options.--fx-bg · --fx-ink · --fx-arrow-bg · --f: Background · text color (default accent · text on accent). For repainting, like the light or dark panels of the header row
options.look: ghost: Ring in the text color with no fill (1px) — button over the yellow band
options.[data-fx-part=lead · label · tail · arro: Left slot (lead) · text slot (label) · right slot (tail, absolute position) · rotating arrow inside the slot (arrow, does not rotate if absent — menu dot icon)

use: See more
note: CSS only. On touch devices and reduced motion, it stays in its resting shape
